findings.evidence: Line 76-78: `∃ a : A ≃ₗ[k] A, ∀ n x, a (A.ρ n x) = A.ρ (MulAut.conjNormal (g : G) n) (a x)`; `MulAut.conjNormal_apply` (mathlib/Mathlib/GroupTheory/GroupAction/ConjAct.lean:251) gives `conjNormal g h = g * h * g⁻¹`.
findings.fix: Reword to e.g. "Conjugation by an element of the inertia group is implemented by an invertible operator on `A`: it intertwines `A.ρ` with its conjugate, by definition of `inertia`."
findings.issue: "An element of the inertia group is implemented by an invertible linear operator" describes the wrong object: the statement produces `a` with `a (A.ρ n x) = A.ρ (conjNormal g n) (a x)`, i.e. an operator implementing *conjugation by* `g` on `N`, not a linear action of `g` itself — the latter is precisely the statement that generally fails and that this file replaces with a projective lift.

findings.evidence: Line 40-41: `variable {k : Type u} {G : Type v} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Group G] {N : Subgroup G} [N.Normal] (A : FDRep k N) [Simple A]` — no `Finite G` and no characteristic hypothesis anywhere in the file.
findings.fix: Replace with "No finiteness assumption on `G`, and no restriction on the characteristic of `k`, is needed."
findings.issue: "No finiteness or characteristic restriction on the group is needed" misattributes characteristic to `G`; characteristic is a property of `k`, and the actual content is that `G` carries no finiteness hypothesis while `k` carries no characteristic hypothesis (only `IsAlgClosed`).

summary: Module docstring and the main theorem are substantively accurate, but two docstrings misstate what is proved: the operator-choice lemma says an inertia element is "implemented" by a linear operator (it is conjugation by that element that is implemented, and linear extension of the element is exactly what fails), and the main theorem attributes "characteristic" to the group rather than the field.
